a_p1: The Appia Road is one of the oldest pathways in the country of Italy. Originally created to act as transport for the Roman militia, it stretched from the heart of the Empire – Rome itself – to the city of Brindisi on the coast. It was created over three hundred years, named after Appius Claudius Caecus, who began the road’s creation during the Samnite Wars. Because the long road, like many that would come after it, began from Rome and spread out to its destination, it’s believed that this was where the saying ‘all roads lead to Rome’ was first coined.
a_p2: This is the road our group was currently traveling on as they made their destination to the capital Rome with

b_p3: What could be said about Rome that others hadn’t said more eloquently?
b_p4: The world’s first true metropolis. A sprawling capital city that had existed for nearly three thousand years in one sense or another. The center of the current world, an empire that would become the blueprint for all future societies to follow, for better or for worse. One merely had to mention the Saint Peter’s Basilica or the Pantheon, and images of constructs that epitomized the pinnacle of human ingenuity and fortitude rose to the forefront of anyone’s mind.
b_p5: Indeed, Rome had once worn the title ‘The Eternal City’ with fitting pride. To the modern person, seeing these buildings still in place would make them wonder what it must’ve been like to walk along the city streets when they were fully-formed, to see the buildings as they originally were, to see the Roman Empire in its original splendor.
b_p6: For Ritsuka and Mash, they got the impossible chance to experience this privilege, and understandably it left them in awe. The streets of Rome were flooded with people, moving to and fro, each on their own personal journey but still having the time to stop and greet their neighbor. Ordinary shopkeepers happily sold their wares, as children ran about with nary a care in the world. All with smiles permanently on their faces. One would think that a war wasn’t going on at all or that there weren’t any monsters roaming about.
b_p7: But for Sora, this city reminded him a lot of Thebes. The clothes the people wore, the buildings, the friendly faces, it was like he was back in Olympus again. It honestly made him wonder if Rome and Olympus were connected in some way because of said similarities.

b_p35_note: He took his phone out, turning the camera on and aimed it at the unsuspecting emperor.
b_p36_note: Nero turned around to face him. She grew curious however as she saw him holding a weird rectangular object. Ritsuka and Mash also heard him and saw the phone in his hand.
b_p38_note: Nero tilted her head to the side, now sounding more confused than curious. She heard it make a ‘clicking’ sound, getting her to blink again. She watched as Ritsuka and Mash lean over his shoulder smiling at whatever it was they were seeing and were even commenting on it.
b_p39: With a cute pout, she marched up to see what was going on. Moving behind them to look over their shoulders, her eyes widened in amazement as she saw herself on the strange object, looking just as she did just now.
b_p40: Nero : What in the world is this!?
b_p40_note: She asked as she excitedly got between Mash and Sora. Doing this caused him to knock his head into Ritsuka and make him lose his grip on the object, allowing her to grab it.
b_p42: Looking at this image of herself, she couldn’t help but look at it in wonder. This image was not unlike the paintings she saw in her life. No, she can’t even call this a painting. There are no brush strokes or anything! It was as if the moment she looked at Sora, he captured it with this strange object.
b_p43: Nero : Such an amazing device! What is it?
b_p43_note: Nero asked, turning to look at Sora, who was rubbing his head while the concerned Mash went to Ritsuka who did the same thing.
b_p45: Sora : With it, I can take pictures, play games and talk with people.
b_p46_note: Nero asked, her smile widening more as she listened. She couldn’t believe that such a thing exists.
b_p47: Sora : Yeah. Here let me show you.
b_p48: After that, he showed Nero various things about the phone and even taught her how to take pictures, which she greatly enjoyed as she took some with her friends and some with the people. However, all fun and games had to end once they reached Nero’s palace.
c_p1: Nero’s throne room was every bit as ostentatious as one would expect from her. With walls made of marble, similarly-made columns stretching up to the ceiling far above their heads, statues of the same make proudly displayed that seemed to be fashioned after her, and a large throne draped in red and gold cloth.
c_p2: Nero : As much as I would like to show you more of my city and treat you as my guests should be, there is still more we should discuss.
c_p2_note: She stated as she took a seat on her throne.
c_p3: Nero : Now then–my Rome is currently being threatened. My territories have been torn from me, and my own forces have been scattered in turn. We are heavily outnumbered, and even with the appearances of others who volunteered to aid me, it has been an uphill battle just to regain control of what I lost.
c_p4: Ritsuka : Just who is the United Roman Empire?
c_p5: Ritsuka : Is there anything you can tell us about them?
c_p6: Nero : It’s an alliance controlled by multiple emperors that suddenly appeared out of nowhere.
c_p7: Nero : The United Roman Empire. That’s what they called themselves when they stole half of my empire. Though they’re still a mystery to us. No matter how many scouts we send out, none ever return. Even the location of the capital where these emperors gather is unknown to us.
c_p8: They can see that her expression is growing more uncomfortable as she speaks.
c_p9: Nero : At first, I had believed them to be pretenders, insulting me by claiming to be superior to me in such a base and classless way. Yet...
c_p9_note: She trailed off, starting to rub the side of her head again.
c_p10: Nero : Caligula, my uncle who passed away when I was young…he was one of them.
c_p10_note: She looked up at the three.
c_p11: Nero : You say that you’re here to help me. Does this mean you know what’s going on?
c_p13: Mash : There is a relic somewhere that is behind the unusual power that the United Roman Empire has and its how the former emperors were able to come back to life. That relic is the Holy Grail, and we’re here to retrieve it before it can cause any more damage.
c_p14_note: Nero answered, a troubled frown crossing her face.
c_p15: Sora blinked at that response, just a tad confused by it.
c_p16: Sora : Have you heard of it?
c_p17: The emperor didn’t answer right away, but he noticed how she reached up and rubbed the side of her head again. It didn’t seem to be as severe this time as it had been before.
c_p18: Nero : Not exactly...it just sounds familiar to me for some reason...
c_p18_note: She commented. She then shook her head and smiled uneasily at them.
c_p19: Nero : Never mind. Perhaps it was just a nightmare I had.
c_p20: They looked curious about that but they didn’t press it further.
c_p21: Olga : [We have reasons to believe that someone, a Mage, brought these emperors to life by using the Holy Grail and is using them to destroy Rome as we speak.]
c_p21_note: Olga weighed in from the communicator.
c_p22: Olga : [Emperor Nero, have you met or seen anyone that looks foreign to you?]
c_p23: Nero : No. The only mage I know was my court mage.
c_p24: Nero : But my uncle killed him before your arrival.
c_p25: Nero : Are they someone you know?
c_p27: Romani : [He was our ally once. But he betrayed us, and killed many of our members before fleeing Chaldea.]
c_p28: Nero gave a frown of sympathy.
c_p29: Nero : I see. I don’t know a man with such a name. However, I did hear the United Empire had a very powerful mage fighting alongside them in the front lines.
c_p30_note: Sora remarked. Ritsuka and Mash nodded in agreement.
c_p31: Nero : Umu. And if that wasn’t bad enough, those strange looking monsters with those weird emblems have been causing nothing but chaos since they arrived.
c_p35: Mash : The monsters with the emblems. That’s what they’re called.
c_p36: Mash : Your Majesty, have they been here long?
c_p37: Nero : They arrived after the United Empire became well known.
c_p37_note: Nero answered, though she looked uncertain.
c_p38: Nero : But…I have a feeling they’ve been around even before them.
c_p40: Nero : Before word on the United Empire spread across Rome, there were reports going around about new types of monsters appearing all over Rome, attacking people.
c_p41: Nero : I also heard that after these monsters attack them, their bodies disappear and all that’s left is a pink glowing crystal. I admit that confused me but also worries me greatly. What exactly are these Heartless?
c_p42: They gave her the basic idea of what they are and she was not happy with what she heard as it showed on her face.
c_p43: Nero : I…I see. So the Heartless are…
c_p43_note: She couldn’t even finish as she placed a hand on her chest, stunned and horrified by what she learned.
c_p44: Nero : My precious people. Their hearts taken, yet no bodies remain. How dare these foul creatures invade my beloved Rome just to spread their darkness!
c_p44_note: She looked furious now at such an unexpected invasion. She took a deep breath and let it out to calm herself.
c_p45: Nero : The United Empire is strong. Very strong. Violent battles are occurring all over and the people suffer. I’ve dispatched all my serving viceroys and generals, and thrown nearly every troop at them. Yet their power is undiminished. During the last assault, they managed to get into the capital. It’s a miracle that we were able to drive them back, but I’m afraid we’re barely hanging on and I know the next assault will be the last.
c_p46: With a sudden exhale, she rose to her feet, stepping off of the throne and walking closer to them, some of her bravado back in her.
c_p47: Nero : I now know more than ever just how dire the situation is. We are surrounded by multiple enemies, both the United Empire and the Heartless as well. And I’m not the type to overlook good fortune when it smiles upon me! So I ask you-no, I implore you! Join forces with me! Help me protect my people from these threats!
c_p47_note: She asked, a hand on her chest.
c_p48: Sora, Ritsuka and Mash shared a look of immediate understanding with each other. Even with their mission, they certainly couldn’t refuse such a passionate plea for aid. They looked at her with gentle but determined smiles.
c_p49: Ritsuka : Did you really have to ask?
c_p50: Mash : Of course we’ll help you, Emperor Nero.
c_p51: Mash : That’s why we’re here after all.
c_p52: Sora : Besides, we’re friends Nero. Friends are always there to help each other.
c_p53: Nero’s eyes widened in delight, her grim demeanor gone and replaced by a brilliant smile.
c_p54: Nero : My friends! My true, dear friends! Thank you so much!
c_p54_note: She conveyed, reaching out and enthusiastically shaking Sora’s hand. She did the same to Ritsuka.
c_p55: Nero : Now I’m certain the gods have sent you! Such an incredible twist of fate for us to meet!
c_p55_note: She continued, moving on to shake Mash’s hand, before pulling away and walking to another part of the throne room.
c_p56: Nero : I shall grant you three the title of viceroy, as well as reward for the work you’ve already done! Treasure, fame, titles! Name it and it will be yours!
c_p57_note: Sora tried to tell her that they really don’t want.
c_p58: Nero : We must prepare a feast at once!
c_p58_note: Nero exclaims, her arms spreader out.
c_p59: Nero : Granted, it may not be as grand as usual due to the war, but it will still be a magnificent feast where I spare no efforts! To properly welcome our new viceroys in a true Roman fashion! I assure you, you must experience such a royal feast! We even managed to acquire some special wine from the Orient, which I have no doubt would be a very rare treat! Thankfully Jing Ke didn’t drink it all before she left!
c_p60: Mash : O-Oh, um, we can’t drink I’m afraid!
c_p61: Ritsuka : Y-Yeah, we’re underage! But thanks for the offer!
c_p61_note: Ritsuka added in with a sheepish smile.
c_p62: Sora : Wait a minute, who’s Jing Ke?
c_p62_note: Sora asked. A name like that sounded like they were from the Land of Dragons, or China as it’s also called. And something told him that this person might be a Servant.
a_p118b: did say that Nero had a lot of magical energy which is impossible for her to have in the current era. But they didn’t know she had this much to stand toe to toe against a Servant, let alone a Berserker!
a_p13a: He never really paid attention to it because of the battle but now that it was over, he finally noticed. In her time,
a_p13b: was able to perfectly hide her true gender, so it would make sense people would mistake her for a boy.
d_p1: After such a chaotic day, everything ended up becoming peaceful. And they greatly enjoyed the feast that Nero had prepared. It was a great night. The Chaldea Trio decided to take a rest in the room provided to them. It was a luxurious room compared to the standard quarters of Chaldea. Marble covered the walls and floor with patterns of gold tracing the room. Their beds were made of velvet rose-covered sheets that felt like silk.
d_p2: Compared to Orleans, this singularity had a much better start. Not only did they make new friends and allies, they also got a base of operations. Overall, a huge improvement.

d_p5_note: Fou yelps next to him, also enjoying the pillow and the overall luxurious lifestyle of Rome.

d_p7: Romani : [Also, a viceroy is a ruler exercising authority on behalf of a sovereign. In other words, you’re serving as Nero’s representatives.]

d_p14: Ritsuka : Don’t worry, I still remember.

d_p26_note: They looked his way in confusion.

d_p28_note: Sora answered, a frown starting to form at what he was about to say next.
d_p29: Sora : She also told me that she heard a beast’s roar. Does anyone know what beast she was talking about?

d_p31_note: Mash asked, placing a hand under her chin and looking as though she was trying to remember something. It did sound familiar but she can’t remember.
d_p33: Ritsuka : I mean he was roaring and howling a lot like a beast. So maybe that roar she heard was him.
d_p34: Sora shook his head and crossed his arms.
d_p35: Sora : Nah. It definitely wasn’t Caligula she heard, otherwise Nero wouldn’t have gained that extra magic boost to finish off him the way she did. If anything…
d_p35_note: His mind raced back to the vision.
d_p36: Sora : This beast she was talking about…it’s almost as if–

d_p39: Sora : Ow! What was that for Fou?
d_p40_note: Fou chirps, smacking his head with his left forepaw.
d_p41: Mash : Um, I think Fou is saying it’s time to go to sleep.
d_p41_note: Mash said with the little beast nodding in agreement.
d_p42: Romani : [I agree. You guys got a big day tomorrow.]
d_p43: Sora blinked several times before he let out a tired yawn.
d_p44: Sora : Yeah. You know what? You’re right, Fou. Guess we should get some shut eyes.
d_p45: Fou let out a huff and went to sleep. The group said their goodnights to each other and went to sleep while Romani shut off communications and went to his room to go to sleep. But the topic they were talking about was enough to make the doctor think about it while he continued on his way.
d_p46: Romani : Nero Claudius, a living ordinary human who somehow gained magical energy to fight against not only the United Roman Empire but also Servants.
d_p46_note: Romani said to himself, placing a hand under his chin.
d_p47: Romani : After Caligula used his Noble Phantasm on her, she said she heard a beast’s roar and she was somehow able to gain an extra boost in magic energy to land a fatal blow enough to kill him. Nero…and a beast…
d_p48: He stopped walking, eyes slowly widening in realization and he felt himself sweating in cold nervousness.
d_p50: The more he kept thinking about it, the more it made sense. The supposed ‘mad tyrant’ Nero Claudius, a beast that only she could hear, her notorious actions later on in life, especially in regards to Christians.
d_p51: Could it really be…? If it’s that Beast from the Book of Revelation, the very same Beast that historians claim Nero shared a connection with…
d_p52: Then things just got a whole lot more complicated in this singularity.

The largest of Italy’s volcanoes, even more than the famous Mount Vesuvius, its infamy is only worsened by the fact that it was still active even in the present day. Which made their mission of ascending the slope to find the leyline just a bit more perilous than it would be otherwise.

They were honestly surprised by how she was okay with it but she told them that her court mage often went there from time to time as well. She told them that it would take days to go there by boat but they already had transportation in mind and reassured her that they’ll be back later.

It also has a Heartless emblem printed on the front of its coat.
